newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norway T-bill expansion gets high yield 3.72 pct.
newsitem.headline: Norway T-bill expansion gets high yield 3.72 pct.

text.p: Norway's central bank, Norges Bank, said on Monday an expansion of a 12-month treasury bill, SS47, produced a highest yield of 3.72 percent.
The bank announced the expansion by two billion crowns on April 30.
The lowest yield at the ordinary auction was 3.69 percent and the weighted average was 3.70 percent.
Bids for the highest accepted rate had a 28 percent allotment.
The T-bill was issued on April 7 at 3.5 billion crowns, with 500 million crowns reserved for the central bank. SS47 has a nominal interest rate of 3.70 percent and matures on March 18, 1998.
